cycles.qualifications: Full-time BE/BTech/four-year BSc Engineering from AICTE-approved college or recognized university in specified Computer Science/IT or Electronics branches. General/OBC/EWS 60%; SC/ST/PwBD 50%. At least four years of post-qualification industrial experience by 1 August 2026; pre-degree work, academic/teaching, research, apprenticeship, banking/financial, nonprofit and curricular internships excluded. Domain-specific experience required; Database Administrator route additionally requires Microsoft SQL certification. Age 35 on 1 August, OBC +3, SC/ST +5, PwBD (at least 40%) +10, additive where applicable; ex-serviceman government-rule relaxation needs verification. Existing BEL fixed-term E-III employees cannot apply laterally to the same post.
cycles.citizenshipRule: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Foreign citizenship, including OCI without Indian citizenship, is not an accepted route in this call.
cycles.residenceRule: No applicant domicile restriction printed; Ghaziabad/Bengaluru unit addresses are not residence rules.
